task.title: Allocation input on a blocked claim

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If no additional weeks need to be processed or paid, select 91 - Overpayment .
If additional weeks need to be processed or paid, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work type: Select the appropriate option:
If the Work item is 91 , select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
If the Work item is 93 , select 33 - Blocked claim requiring payment .

Remarks Line 1: Type “Input M107 [action type] [w/c - start date] - [w/c - end date] [number of weeks] [type of monies (e.g. P - Preventative Withdrawal, S - Separation pay benefits, W - Workers’ compensation benefits)] [apply UP to OP, if necessary].”
Remarks Line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if a subsequent claim needs to be postdated due to the BP extension:

ul.li: If no, go to step 5.

If yes and the claim is active, input the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction with the required information for the recalculation to postdate the subsequent BPC. If it is not possible to postdate the BPC using the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create a second Operational Centre Memo (MM06) . Refer to MM06 Benefit period: BPC change (antedate and postdate) — Transaction to send the information to IPOC, indicating to process both MM06 transactions. MM06 Benefit period: BPC change (antedate and postdate) — Transaction

If yes and the claim is blocked, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create a second Operational Centre Memo (MM06) . Refer to MM06 Benefit period: BPC change (antedate and postdate) — Transaction to send the information to IPOC, indicating to process both MM06 transactions. MM06 Benefit period: BPC change (antedate and postdate) — Transaction

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
